name: our-trip
description: Development tools only (type checking, lint, format). Nothing from node_modules is published: the site in web/ runs as-is.

scripts.types: json2ts -i schema/trip.schema.json -o types/trip.d.ts --no-additionalProperties --unreachableDefinitions --bannerComment "/* Generated from schema/trip.schema.json by `npm run types`. Do not edit: change tools/src/trip_tools/model.py, then run `trip schema` and `npm run types`. */"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
